none: PAS LIN-3D76C2: Middle Roman silver finger ring
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

FIND LIAISON'S REPORT. Description of find. A silver Roman finger ring, Henig type XI. The ring has a broad flat bezel and a tapering hoop. The bezel is very corroded however it is possible that a feint letter 'o' is inscribed in the centre indicating that this may originally have been inscribed with the letters 'ToT', which is an inscription common to finger rings of this type in the region
